text:
joe (release-lead): Quick sync — drafting the internal RN for tonight's deploy. Need one-liner + 3 bullets we can blast to staff. Target change window 23:00 UTC.
sasha (product): One-liner: "Redwood API: improved batching + stability fixes". Bullets: reduced gen latency for short prompts, opt-in batching improvements, fixed edge-case in kv-cache expiry.
maria (eng): + confirm quantized model pinned to v1.4-quant for canary. We should include rollback target (v1.3-stable) in the RN.
joe (release-lead): Good. Maria — can you drop the exact pin string? ops needs it for deploybot.
maria (eng): Pin: model=redwood-7b-quant@2026-03-21-1. Deploybot will route canary to 2 nodes, then 10 nodes.
joe (release-lead): Tim, oncall: are you ok with 23:00 UTC change window and 60m standby?
tim-oncall: yep 23:00 UTC works for me. 60m standby sounds fine. If error rate > 2% in canary, initiate rollback.
joe (release-lead): deploybot, schedule canary per the plan.
deploybot: Scheduled: canary start=1717460400 (23:00 UTC), canary nodes=2, expand=10 @ +10m, health-checks every 30s.
sasha (product): For RN wording, short bullets: 1) latency down ~12% on short prompts, 2) improved batching reduces token cost for chat flows, 3) fixed session KV expiry causing stale context.
maria (eng): Also include note: "Model pinned for canary—if canary shows perf regression, ops will rollback to v1.3-stable and re-run smaller quant test."
joe (release-lead): Draft internal blurb —
joe (release-lead): "Heads-up: Deploy tonight 23:00 UTC — Redwood API minor performance & stability release. Canary rollout to 2 nodes, expand to 10 if healthy. Pinned model: redwood-7b-quant@2026-03-21-1. Rollback plan: revert to v1.3-stable on any >2% request error rate or sustained latency regression. Oncall: @tim-oncall."
sasha (product): Add link to perf dashboard: https://console.redwood.company/perf/runs/2026-03-21-1 :thumbsup:
maria (eng): Quick deploy note for ops channel (copyable):
```
# deploybot command
/deploy canary --model redwood-7b-quant@2026-03-21-1 --nodes 2 --expand 10 --health 30s --rollback-tag v1.3-stable
```
joe (release-lead): Perfect. I'll paste RN into internal-announce at T-30 and pin in eng-releases. Maria — please attach the rollout playbook to the doc.
maria (eng): Done, uploaded playbook: https://files.redwood.company/playbooks/rn-2026-03-21-canary.md
tim-oncall: I'll be in standby; set pager threshold for p50+p95 spikes + error rate >2%.
deploybot: Canary started (simulated) — health=OK on 2/2 nodes.
sasha (product): Nice. I'll tidy microcopy and send the internal announce at T-30.
joe (release-lead): Thanks all — keep replies short in this thread for blameless audit. :white_check_mark:
